---

Compare original vs gaze-regressed pupil signals and their associations with arousal.

```{r}
source("~/Desktop/VRMID-analysis/mid-pupil/analyses/load_libraries.R")
```

## Load processed datasets

```{r}
vrmid1 <- read_csv("~/Desktop/VRMID-analysis/mid-pupil/data/vrmid1/derivatives/pupillometry_lowpass_baselineCorrected.csv")
vrmid2 <- read_csv("~/Desktop/VRMID-analysis/mid-pupil/data/vrmid2/derivatives/pupillometry_baselineCorrected.csv")
```

## Example participant timecourse overlay

```{r}
example_sub <- vrmid2 %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(n_arousal = sum(!is.na(arousal)),
            n_both_signal = sum(!is.na(pupil_Avg_scaled) & !is.na(pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_arousal > 20, n_both_signal > 500) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_arousal), desc(n_both_signal)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(Subject)

example_df <- vrmid2 %>%
  filter(Subject == example_sub,
         sample_in_trial_t >= 0,
         Time_sec >= 0) %>%
  mutate(sample_point = row_number()) %>%
  select(Subject, trial, sample_point, sample_in_trial_t, arousal_start, Time,
         pupil_Avg_scaled, pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pupil_Avg_scaled, pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled),
               names_to = "signal",
               values_to = "pupil_value")

ggplot(example_df,
       aes(x = sample_point, y = pupil_value, color = signal)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pupil_Avg_scaled" = "steelblue4",
                                "pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled" = "firebrick3")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = paste0("Example participant: ", example_sub),
       x = "Sample index (continuous)",
       y = "Scaled pupil",
       color = "Signal")
```

## Trial-level correlation with arousal

```{r}
trial_level <- bind_rows(
  vrmid1 %>%
    mutate(study = "vrmid1"),
  vrmid2 %>%
    mutate(study = "vrmid2")
) %>%
  group_by(study, Subject, trial) %>%
  summarise(
    arousal = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(first(na.omit(arousal)))),
    mean_pupil_Avg_scaled = mean(pupil_Avg_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled = mean(pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(arousal))

trial_level_long <- trial_level %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_pupil_Avg_scaled, mean_pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled),
               names_to = "signal",
               values_to = "pupil_value")

corr_summary <- trial_level_long %>%
  group_by(study, signal) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(pupil_value) & !is.na(arousal)),
    r = cor(pupil_value, arousal, use = "complete.obs"),
    p_value = cor.test(pupil_value, arousal)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

corr_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(trial_level_long,
       aes(x = pupil_value, y = arousal, color = signal)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~study, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("mean_pupil_Avg_scaled" = "steelblue4",
                                "mean_pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled" = "firebrick3")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Mean pupil signal (trial-level)",
       y = "Self-reported arousal",
       color = "Signal")
```
